assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent animation sprite, raven-up.png, exactly 1024 x 1024 square PNG.
Input images: Image 1 is the reference raven identity and feather palette. Image 2 is STYLE ONLY, not a character to include.
Primary request: a single side-view raven flying toward the RIGHT, wings raised high above its back in the upstroke pose, an authentic first frame of a two-frame flapping animation. Scratchy Don't Starve Together inspired hand-ink cutout, black and dark maroon feathers with sparse muted brown hatch highlights, jagged feather tips, dark pointed beak facing right.
Composition: entire raven contained with generous transparent margin. Fixed animation anchor: torso center at x=512 y=512; horizontal tail extends left to around x=230 y=555; head centered around x=725 y=480 and beak points toward x=825 y=495; small tucked feet below body around x=565 y=600. Wings reach high around y=130, never clipped. Side profile not frontal.
Background: genuinely transparent alpha, no backdrop, no colored field, no ground shadow, no checkerboard illustration.
Constraints: one raven only, no people, no text, no UI, no border. Strong hand-drawn flat cutout silhouette, no photorealism, no glossy 3D. Preserve body/head/feet positions for next wing-down frame.

Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: raven-down.png, transparent square PNG exactly 1024 x 1024, second frame of a two-frame wing-flap animation.
Input image: edit target, the existing wing-up raven. Keep its body, tail, head, eye, beak and feet absolutely identical in design, scale, rotation and pixel location on the canvas. Preserve same black-maroon palette and scratchy Don't Starve Together hand-ink cutout style.
Change ONLY the wing pose: rotate both wings at the shoulder down beneath the body to show the clear downstroke, long primary feathers extending toward bottom of canvas. Remove the entire raised-wing silhouette above the back, leaving real alpha transparency there. The DOWN wings must be obviously below the torso, distinct from the supplied UP pose. The body does not move, face and beak still point RIGHT. Do not vertically squash the whole raven; anatomically redraw the articulated wings only.
Composition: same square canvas and fixed body/head/tail/feet positions as reference. All wing tips within canvas, trim primary length only if needed for containment. Do not enlarge the bird to fill canvas. Background genuinely transparent alpha, no checkerboard pixels, no colored background. No people, text, UI, border or shadow.

Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: map-room.png, full opaque illustrated environment, exact 1024 x 1536 portrait PNG for a gothic wedding invitation scene.
Input images: Image 1 reference for the immediately adjoining clock-room's architecture, palette, rose ornamentation, warm light and illustrated rendering; Image 2 STYLE ONLY scratchy hand-ink character reference, DO NOT include any people.
Primary request: the adjacent map study inside this same gothic manor, where visitors approach an antique wooden desk to learn the wedding venue. Coherent scratchy Don't Starve Together inspired hand-ink illustration, warm muted amber morning light, near-black carved wood and dark maroon palette.
Composition: portrait room view, a wide ornate wooden map desk centered in the LOWER MIDDLE, the upper desk surface around 55 to 65 percent of image height. A large blank antique parchment map lies open across the desk; parchment may show delicate border weathering and extremely faint nonspecific decorative map-like marks, but absolutely no readable writing, no place labels, no fake accurate geography. Keep a generous low-detail dark wall area centered ABOVE the desk between about 25 and 50 percent of image height, suitable for venue text overlay added later in code. Leave foreground patterned floor visible across the bottom quarter. Gothic bookcase with worn books to a side, tall pointed window casting warm morning light from a side, black-maroon curtains with subtle rose patterns, restrained rose arrangement/detail. Same architectural world as clock-room, but no giant clock here.
Style/medium: richly hand-drawn angular ink outlines and scratchy hatching, illustrated textured wood, maroon gothic romance, not photorealistic or 3D. Balanced space, readable desk silhouette, parchment central focal point.
Constraints: no people, no raven, no text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no typography, no watermark, no poster border, no transparency. Full illustration to all edges.
